description: A German fact asked about with a synonym and no shared content word, with a lexical control question. Limit: recall is word overlap only when no embedding model is configured. Failure means: expected without embeddings (the synonym question cannot be retrieved); with a real embedding model it is expected to pass, and the control probe must pass in both runs. Maintenance: no seed, so maintenance on or off changes nothing; run with both embedding settings.
